semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company distributes high-end components used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Beijing Huacheng Qingda Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the sales and service of high-end imported components for the semiconductor industry. They also engage in independent research and development, launching products that support chip manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.China: The company has a branch office in Suzhou to better serve customers in East China.
